balls.text: misses out on the full toss as the bat faces turns in his hand, gets a single towards midwicket
this is better, almost a yorker, Yuvraj looks to open the face on it, and is beaten outside off

misses the yorker again, this time on the other side. This is a low full toss, and how well and effortlessly Yuvraj has sent it sailing over midwicket. We are talking of inches as the margin of error here
good comeback, inch perfect yorker, dug out back to Southee
That is Yuvraj... clean swing, clean connection, and six down the ground. He is down on a knee, the length ball lets him get under it, and he goes over long-off
plays the scoop, Southee sees him looking for it, and bowls wide of off, but Yuvraj still manages enough connection to clear the short fine leg
full delivery, heaved away into the on side, gets a single to deep midwicket
another short ball that has jammed the batsman, will be just a single to short fine
slower ball, plays and misses, wants the bye, is sent back by Yuvraj. Would have been run out had Dhoni's underarm flick hit
near-yorker, whipped away to midwicket for one

Another short delivery gets a wicket. Bollinger has been hurrying the Pune batsman all day long, the same happens with Marsh, whose bottom hand comes off the bat as he pulls this. The top edge is accepted by Aswhin at deep square
looks for the slog and misses the line of the ball, which is angled across him
lovely yorker, middle and off, no room, digs it out, but back to the bowler
good yorker wide outside off, gets just the single
low full toss, whipped towards midwicket, hits Jakati on the half-volley. He takes the single off the ricochet
gets the yorker right this time, will only be a single to long-off
Pummelled! Sothee misses the yorker by inches, and he smashes it down the ground and along the ground. There is a long-off, but he hardly has to run to his left and save this
legal delivery this time, driven to sweeper-cover for one
another wide - the plan seems to be to go full and wide, and twice he has been too wide
this is sufficiently wide outside off to not be argued about
slower ball, offcutter, beaten as he looks to open the face on this
very well bowled... called a wide? Oh come on! He saw Marsh back away, bowled full and wide, and it landed inside the crease, and also inside the guide lines. That's a harsh harsh call
plays and misses as he backs away ad looks to hit this square. The ball passes over the stumps
nicely guided square of third man, and comes back for two
another mis-timed pull lands safely, the top edge falls between the midwicket and deep square leg running around
short ball, hurries onto him, but he still manages to clear the midwicket inside the circle
Clean strike. Yuvraj sees mid-off up in the circle, and chips this length ball over him. The timing is so clean it goes all the way
short and flat, pushed down the ground for one
worked away into the leg side, will come back for two
Big appeal. Arm ball. Hurries onto him as Yuvraj looks to cut, but bat and pad are close together, and there seems to be a feather on it
defended off the front foot
lovely shot... Yuvraj was pushing forward when he saw this being bowled short. Very quickly he transferred the weight back and casually pulled it over midwicket. Lovely timing
pushed down to long-on for one
long hop, pulled away disdainfully and square, much-needed four runs
short and wide, cut away, Vijay from sweeper-cover runs to his right and makes a diving save to save two runs for his team
comes down the track, covers the spin, gets a single to long-on
there is impressive turn to be had every time you bowl slower through the air. As Raina does this time, and beats him. Heading down leg, though
played with the turn, to midwicket
pauses in the delivery stride, bowls flat, marsh defends it back to him
slower through the air, Yuvraj is way too early into the sweep and is beaten as it turns and bounces. Ashwin has a huge smile on his face. A smile of a man who knows he is bowling very well
flat, quick offbreak, pitches off and middle, and turns away. Defended
really really slow through the air, stays back, waits for it to turn, works it away on the on side
offbreak, around off, defended

Another carrom ball. This time Ashwin is the one smiling. This is pitched outside leg, Uthappa goes for the shot into the leg side, the ball turns away, takes the leading edge. Caught at short third. What a bowler
Carrom ball. Deposited in the stands. This one is a half-tracker, and Uthappa is quick to pull this cleanly over midwicket
opens the face, can't beat short third man
Under-edge for four. Looking for the sweep to cow corner, but is early into the shot. He will take those four runs, though
flat and quick, played back to Raina
Incredible shot, although it gets him just the one. This pitched off, turned in, but he late-cut it from in front of middle. Except there was a third man placed deep
goes for the reverse sweep, Raina keeps it short, and beats him outside what would have been his off stump
angled into the pads, gets just the one to short fine
tries the paddle sweep, but the short fine leg is very fine
That's one way of ensuring enough time between deliveries. Just send it into the stands and relax and take your time. Slog-swept over cow corner, way into the stands
sharp turn again, quick turn too, lobs off the pad towards short fine
there is turn here, but the ball is too short, and too slow. Cut away for one
swept to deep backward square for one
heave-ho, miss-ho, no run. Ho
yorker, Yuvraj digs it back to the bowler
picks the single to short fine leg now. Somewhere LS must be saying this is smart batting because he has followed a boundary up with a single
this is short and wide, and despite the sharp turn. Uthappa cuts it away for four
looks to cut, not short enough, and hits it straight to point
another paddle, another couple fine of fine leg
paddled away fine, but big man Bollinger makes a diving save at the fence, saving a couple of runs
driven down to long-on, another single
driven with the spin, to sweeper-cover
clipped off the pads for one
goes straight after pitching, Uthappa looks to run it down, can't beat short third
pushed down to long-on now
pitched up around middle and off, defended
reverse-sweep to counter the turn, and he does it well, beating both the slip and the short third man
Too good. Angling in, making him play, turning away sharply, missing the edge by inches
comes down the track, gets too close to the ball, and can't get elevation. Just the single to long-on
back of a length, around off, pushed to short midwicket
sharp turn from middle and leg, clipped away into the leg side, keeping it down
overpitched on the pads, but played to short midwicket
slower ball, Yuvraj checks the drive, keeps it down, towards cover
That's a brute! Headed straight for the helmet grille. Yuvraj has to fend at it, and manages to keep it down. Chennai using the short ball well
clipped away off the pads, wide of deep midwicket, comes back for two
gets across, and plays this full ball in front of his front pad. You miss this, and you are dead plumb. this time, though, he doesn't, and gets a single

another short ball, another poor shot, Pune are four down! He is no position to play this pull. On the front foot, late into the shot, ends up hitting it straight down mid-on's lap. Once again, Pune have lost four even before reaching 50 runs
back of a length, off stump and thereabouts, no room, played back to the bowler
turning into the pads, helped away for a single
well bowled, sharp offbreak, pitches middle and turns away, gets a very thick edge that flies wide of the slip
tossed up, Pandey's heave finds itself short of the pitch of the ball. Ends up hitting it much squarer than intended
slow through the air, around middle and off, defended back
premeditated sweep, the bat comes down on the ball, ruling out a top edge
short and flat delivery to start with, played back to Ashwin
misses out on this inswinger on the pads with short fine up in the circle. Cannot beat that fielder, and gets just the couple
shuffles across to cover the movement, Kula bowls on the pads, and is flicked away for one
Majestic shot! Stands tall, plants the front foot down, and drives away from the body, on the up, between cover and extra cover
... and nearly out goes Yuvraj Singh! The inswinger again. Yuvraj drives at this, but the movement takes a thick outside edge that just about manages to elude backward point

Has he bowled him? Yes he has. They are busy running runs, but he has been bowled here. One of Kula's famous big inswingers that finds a way between his bat and pad, and kisses the leg bail on the way. Nobody notices this. Dhoni fumbles, and goes back to field the ball. The batsmen are running... and Kula notices the leg bail has been dislodged. And then he politely appeals. Three down
starts with an inswinger, which is steered away from in front of middle stump
plays this push-drive on the run, and gets a single to wide of mid-off
Runs finally! Did Southee try too hard with this outswinger? Pitching on the pads, and Pandey clips it past midwicket. Good timing
really nice, sharp bouncer, Pandey is ages away from making contact with it as he looks to pull
width there, crunchy shot, but straight to point on the bounce
better delivery, starts middle, swings away, nearly squares him up as he defends it back
a gentle outswinger outside off, pushed to cover
cuts him in two as the ball comes back in a touch - a double-wicket maiden here!
another leave outside off
angled away, left alone

Another short ball, another wicket! Pune disintegrating once again? Poor poor shot. He pulls but the weight doesn't go back, the ball gets a bit too big, and all he manages is a tame lob to short midwicket
back of a length, outside off, played back to Bollinger
Gone. It's a very good short delivery. Following him and higher than the chest, Ryder hardly gets any power behind it, and Anirudha takes a nice low catch at midwicket
full toss hit straight to straightish midwicket
looks to drive through the covers, gets too close to it, and ends up hitting right back into the pitch
ahhh... looks to pull this from way outside off, the ball takes the toe end, and goes towards long-off
Make it three for Jesse. Makes room this time to counter the angle, and goes inside-out over extra cover. Each shot better than the previous one
lovely straight loft, his sole aim was to clear the infield with this - almost a chip. And the timing is so good it almost carries on for a six
superb short-arm pull. Picked the length very early, stayed still in the crease, and swung it over square leg. Lands a couple of feet inside the fence
wide down the leg side, swinging more after passing the stumps
comes at Bollinger once again, and swings wildly... at thin air, way inside the line of a length ball angling away from him
angling into the pads, worked away for a single
swings away from wide outside off, Ryder drives powerfully, but can't beat the widish mid-off
edged away past the lone slip. To be fair to Ryder, his hands were soft and it wouldn't have carried to a second slip
short ball, hurries onto him, limply pulled away for one
Mishra charges at him, makes room too... so much room that he can't reach this half-volley outside off
back of a length, no room, Ryder plays it back to Kula
slight inswing this time as this pitches outside leg and takes the leading edge as Ryder looks to turn this to leg
nice punch from just outside off, can't pierce the heavily populated cover ring
nearly played on trying to run it down, hits the back pad off the inside edge
punched outside off, towards short cover, no swing again
no swing, which is strange for Kula. Ryder works a length ball off the pads for one
wristed away between mid-on and midwicket by a jubilant Badri. he has pulled off a superb, efficient chase. he hugs Raina. Dhoni applauds in the dugout
yorker, digs it out for a single to mid-off, who for some reason is hanging at the circle when two are required off five. All night they have hit straight to Taylor and stolen singles
low full toss, gets a leading edge as Raina looks to turn this to leg. Dot ball
full toss on the pads, they try to steal a single to short fine, and they succeed in doing so despite the direct hit
short, on the pads, pulled away for another single
full and fast, helped into the on side for a single
square-drive, gets Badri another single
quick ball, pushed into the covers for another single
sharp turn for him, helped past point for one
Another mis-hit for six! These bats I tell you. Slower ball again, he has got Raina playing too early, it's just a check chip, the bottom hand comes off too, but it still clears long-off. Game over
slower offcutter, just back of a length, no room, hit back to Taylor
that is better, the quicker bouncer, Raina doesn't need to flirt with it - the asking rate is under control
one slower bouncer too many. Raina is expecting it, and upper-cuts it for another couple
That should decide the game. Length ball, around off, and Raina clears the front leg and lofts this over long-off
slower short delivery, offcutter too, Raina stays back and can't do much other than block it
yorker, squirted down to third man for one
makes room, meets this in front of leg, drives it past extra cover
overpitched, pushed down to long-on for a single
important shot, gets inside the line of a short ball, pulls it along the ground, beats fine leg
moves right across the stumps, and flicks this down to fine of fine leg
good bouncer, head-high... wait a minute, perhaps a few inches too high, and called a wide. Harsh call, I would say, Badri wasn't upright
pulled away to deep square for a single. Badri back on strike
quick again, Raina helps it along to short fine for another single - six of those from this over
comes down the track, gets the inside half on this shot, falls short of long-on
quick delivery, very quick, 103ks, pulled away for a single
looks to chip down the wicket, sees a flat delivery, goes back and runs it down to short third
turned around the corner, hands over the strike
goes inside-out, chips it down to long-on. Soft hands mean it will fall short of long-off
another slower short ball, Raina has no clue about it as it bounces twice on the way to Uthappa
sower short ball, steered down to third man for a single
good yorker, follows him too as he looks to make room. Valuable dot
short ball, pulled between deep square and deep midwicket - a richly deserved half-century
slower ball, wide of off as he sees Badri back away. Badri plays it with an open face, but straight to point
Starts with a sharp bouncer, beats him on the pull. Dot
squeezes a near yorker out, and gets a single to extra cover
Another beautiful shot, it's a half-volley all right, but he has driven it between the bowler and long-on. No chance for the fielder
another stroke of luck, makes room and heaves, and just about manages an inside edge
well bowled, doesn't deserve to go for four! It's a yorker, maybe six inches short, and Badri makes room, and squeezes it between backward point and short third man
a tip and run to cover, gives the strike over to Badri
turned around the corner for another single
runs this down to short third, and Raina takes Taylor on. Direct hit would have got him
Another beautiful inside-out shot... Just the chip, and not many times do you see a deep extra cover, do you?
pushed down to long-on for an easy single
turned away into the leg side, soft hands mean they have time to come back for two before the deep fielders can come in
back of a length, angling across, Raina stays back to defend it
another slower ball, yorks him as he looks to make room
length ball, around off, pushed to cover
Jissy! Finally one edge lands with a fielder. Slower legcutter wide outside off, Vijay is clearly early into it, and the thick edge goes flying to sweeper-cover, who has to run in a few paces
beautiful square-drive, just for a single, but good-looking shot on the up
slower legcutter, pitches outside off, turns away, left alone. Called a wide
more peaceful this time, pushing this down to long-on for a singe
and he is greeted with a huge six! Vijay goes deep into the crease, takes this leg-stump half-volley, and sends it sailing over midwicket
topspinner, cramps him up as he looks to run it down
more luck for Chennai. Sharma sees Vijay charge at him, bowls it short. The extra bounce means he has not connected well, but it falls short of long-off
overpitched outside off, driven wide of sweeper-cover for two
full again, pushed to long-on for a single
too full, on the pads, flicked wide of deep midwicket for two

Big shout, but not given. Pune can't believe it, even Yuvraj Singh comes to the umpire Shastri for a chat. And who can blame them? Badri looks to run this down, gets a thin edge, there is deviation, some sound is also there. Uthappa thinks he has taken a sharp catch, Shastri doesn't
nicely tossed up outside off, played straight to straightish extra cover
back of a length, pushed down to long-off for another single
Beautiful shot, this is a bit of an exhibition. Makes room, comes down, is not to the pitch of it, and just caresses this inside-out, but the timing is so good long-off has no chance
short delivery, hit down the ground for another single
angled into the pads, worked away for another single
wide of off, cut away to deep point for one
sharp turn for Kartik, beats Badri's attempt at playing this to on
One domestic stalwart is taking another domestic stalwart apart. Comes down the track, gets the expected flat delivery, and then opens the face on it to get a four square off the wicket
Vijay comes down, turns this into a half-volley, pushes this to long-on
angled into the pads, worked away for an easy single
Takes the long-off on and clears him with a mis-hit! Goes inside-out again, the ball dips on him, he doesn't get much of a connection, but the ball still clears Jerome Taylor by inches
Lovely shot, comes down, stays outside the line, and goes inside-out, straight of long-off for a four
moves across, gets inside the line of another flat delivery, guides it towards fine leg for one
flat and quick, no room, tips and runs
looks for the late cut, makes room, makes good connection, but can't beat short third man
tossed up, yorks him, Badri digs it out but back to Sharma
overpitched on the pads, pushed down to long-on
angled down the leg side, no turn, called a wide
short, skidding on, they take a single off the mis-timed pull
driven square, a single means five from the over
a quick single to backward point, a direct hit, but safely home
fired in at leg stump, into the pads
squirted through the same area, this time yielding two. Some turn...
pushed to backward point, no runs there
Vijay reaches this on the full and punches to wide long on
Jammed down on it and another single taken as the ball rolls towards the 'keeper
Angling into the pads and worked away for a single
Too full outside off and driven past extra cover
that was full and pretty straight, but not straight enough for the umpire. Hit in front of middle and leg, front pad and a hint of swing saved him perhaps
a sharp single taken after Vijay pushes past the bowler
full and straight, a leg bye scrambled
another full ball, another defensive push. Wicket maiden!
over-pitched and driven to mid on
angled towards leg stump and thudding into the pad
straight, flat and pushed out onto the off side

pulled to deep midwicket, a low catch is taken by Pandev, diving forward... or is it? On referral to the third umpire, Hussey is sent on his way. Looked like fingers, ball and grass made contact simultaneously. A bold decision
full outside off and pushed to cover
A hint of Azhar about those wrists, two to straight midwicket
short of a length outside off stump and glided down to third man for a single
far too short this time and a no-ball for height. No free hit
slower bouncer irks Vijay but his hesitant pull shot lands safely inside the fielding circle, not carrying to short fine leg
another bumper, this time noted by the umpires as one for the over
short and fairly tight to off stump, whizzes past Vijay's helmet grill
full, fast and angled towards leg stump, flicked away by Vijay for a couple
short and down the leg side, an obvious wide
He has had to manufacture this one. Charges at him, Thomas goes short again but provides him with the width, and he crashes this past point
clipped off the pads, gets a single
slower ball on the pads, flicked away, but can't get it past short fine
fuller, around middle and leg, Hussey stays in the crease and defends
comes down the track this time, Thomas drops it short, Hussey pulls, gets the inside half of the bat, past short fine leg for a couple
back of a length, just outside off, goes back to defend it to cover
shortish and wide, angling away, Hussey is beaten on the cut. Called a wide, though. Harsh call. Hussey had reached it without any frantic effort, and his bat swung under the ball
pushed wide of mid-off, gets the single
Sharp bouncer, 139.1ks, but it well directed, over the middle stump. Uthappa makes an overhead collection. Called one for the over
slower ball, looks to tip and run, but two cover fielders are alert and make him decide against the single
fuller, swinging away, hit straight to mid-off, and rushes for a single. Continues with the edgy running from the last game. Pune continue missing the stumps
this one goes straight from a similar line and length. Vijay solid in defence
Good start. Just back of a length, around off, slight shape away. Can't do much with that
outswing again, headed towards off and middle. Just short of a length. Defended back to him. Top start from Thomas. Maiden over
back of a length, around off, not much room, played to point
the other way this time, just the angle, and he has Hussey feeling for the swing. Beats the outside edge with the angle. Hussey nods in acknowledgement
gives him the driving length this time, but the ball is swinging. Played straight to mid-on
on target, pitches about middle, and then swings in again. Defended this time
some outswing right away, hits him on the pad, and Uthappa makes a diving collection
